{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping missing values
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean(numeric_only=True)

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Print the result
print(highest_mean_species)"}
